scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: The discovery club considers a helper to organise illustrated leaf cards. It will suggest groups while a learner checks them. A second proposal would secretly score children from their private messages, which does not belong in this classroom project.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: Meera asks four questions: what useful task is being done, which relevant examples are needed, how will fresh checks work and who reviews mistakes? A simple manual sorter may already meet the goal. Choosing AI is not the goal by itself.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The team prepares fictional cards, keeps separate checks and writes down a case needing human review. They compare the helper with manual sorting before deciding. They can revise or stop the project when the evidence does not support its purpose or the proposed data is inappropriate.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The class has fictional leaf cards and a teacher who can review suggestions. It does not have permission to collect private messages. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
